### Overview

In this practical session, we will model and map the habitat suitability for the Asian tiger mosquito in Northern Italy based
on variables derived from daily Land Surface Temperature (LST) data.

We will roughly go through the following steps:
<img src="../assets/img/studio/aedes_albopictus.jpg" width="30%" align="right"/>

  - Import species records
  - Create random background points
  - Create environmental layers from daily LST data
  - Train a species distribution model
  - Evaluate model's prediction
  - Visualize results

![](../assets/img/workflow_sdm_other.png){width="85%" fig-align="center"}


### Data

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="38%"}
![](../assets/img/studio/lst_north_italy_2014.png){width=100%}
:::

::: {.column width="62%"}
- Records of *Aedes albopictus* (Asian tiger mosquito) in Northern Italy downloaded from [GBIF](https://www.gbif.org/)
- Average daily MODIS LST reconstructed by [mundialis GmbH & Co. KG](https://www.mundialis.de/en/) based on @metz_new_2017:
    - 1 km spatial resolution
    - Converted to Celsius degrees
:::

::::
